rows.before_commit: Reserve typed quantity and source/destination identity; visible hands/load match custody.
rows.commit_authority: One transfer event atomically debits source and credits destination.
rows.after_commit: Receipt persists; later animation completes presentation only.
rows.interruption_recovery: Before commit release/revalidate claim; after commit replay receipt without second debit/credit. Full/changed destination retains source cargo.

rows.before_commit: Check approved goal, price version, prerequisite, ordinary budget and protected reserve; reserve remaining bill only.
rows.commit_authority: Atomic contribution ledger; final concurrent contribution activates plot once.
rows.after_commit: Plot identity, contribution and construction state persist together.
rows.interruption_recovery: Refund uncommitted reservation; keep committed progress. Revoked budget stops new debit. Never create a second plot or spend premium.

rows.before_commit: Reserve available inputs and output slot; recipe/ID/version known.
rows.commit_authority: Input debit and job identity persist atomically; completion creates output once.
rows.after_commit: Output custody remains machine until valid collection.
rows.interruption_recovery: Restore committed job phase; no repeated input debit/output grant. Blocked output pauses without deleting inputs/product.

rows.before_commit: Customer order, goods custody and agreed ordinary price reserved.
rows.commit_authority: Goods handoff and earned cash receipt commit once.
rows.after_commit: Cash moves till→carrier→house by conserved transfer; these are custody, not currencies.
rows.interruption_recovery: Resume correct side of receipt. No unpaid duplicated goods or cash. Cancelled/expired uncommitted order preserves owned stock.

rows.commit_authority: One valid contact group applies authoritative damage at actual contact.
rows.interruption_recovery: Uncommitted cancelled/missed hit causes no damage; committed contact cannot be repeated by reload, overlap or actor swap.

rows.before_commit: Target is an eligible hostile/hunt source, never friendly/rescue identity.
rows.commit_authority: Unique defeat transition and reward identity claim once.
rows.after_commit: Drop/reward custody and enemy cleared state persist.
rows.interruption_recovery: Simultaneous allies/reload cannot duplicate drop/XP/cash. Leash/reset/evacuation produces no kill reward.

rows.before_commit: Downed/retreating identity and conserved cargo move to recovery custody; stale job claims release. Before any restored camp exists, the guaranteed arrival anchor remains a valid recovery destination.
rows.commit_authority: Free care completion restores that identity once.
rows.after_commit: Revalidate suspended job, gear, destination and budget; choose useful fallback if changed. Player return restores full current health and usable controls/camera.
rows.interruption_recovery: Kill during evacuation/care returns the same actor/cargo to one valid state; all-helpers-down remains recoverable by player.

rows.before_commit: Validate unlocked route, suitable destination/staging and party/cargo snapshot.
rows.commit_authority: One transition journal binds origin/destination and owned identities.
rows.after_commit: Arrive safely and revalidate destination jobs; free return route remains.
rows.interruption_recovery: Interrupted load resumes either committed destination or saved origin, never duplicated companions or stranded inventory.

rows.before_commit: Verified connection, server time and eligible event/version/objective/prerequisites required. Offline event credit pauses with an explicit notice; no event inputs are consumed. Core ordinary offline play continues.
rows.commit_authority: Server completion receipt before expiry atomically creates a durable earned reward claim; unique claim key grants it once.
rows.after_commit: Earned claim remains deliverable after event expiry/kill switch. UI shows earned only after the completion receipt; earlier network work is pending.
rows.interruption_recovery: If the receipt committed but its response was lost, reconnect resolves the same claim and grants once, even after expiry. Without a verified completion receipt there is no earned reward; expired uncompleted objectives grant nothing. Rollback cannot erase legitimate committed entitlement.

rows.before_commit: Explicit player purchase; store/server receipt and account verified.
rows.commit_authority: Server receipt ID grants premium/entitlement once.
rows.after_commit: Permanent VIP and advertised items retain restore/refund policy.
rows.interruption_recovery: Pending/duplicate/refund/account-change uses verified receipt state; no local fabricated grant or helper-initiated purchase.

save_contract: Durable atomic journal/snapshot and recoverable version migration; UI lifecycle state alone is not durable inventory. Core local play remains usable offline; server-authoritative value remains pending/unavailable until verified.
